children: Multiple state-run companies including Coal India, ONGC, among others will trade ex-dividend from this week. This, along with many other companies will also have their corporate actions taking place during the course of the week. The week will also see India Glycols trade ex-dividend for the demerger of its multiple entities. Here's a complete list of the corporate actions this week:
Glenmark Pharma (Interim Dividend of ₹2.5), ION Exchange (Dividend of ₹1.25), Mastek (Final Dividend of ₹16), Triveni Engineering & Industries (Final Dividend of ₹1.25).

CCL Products (Final Dividend of ₹3), Garware Technical Fibres (Final Dividend of ₹1), Maharashtra Seamless (Dividend of ₹10), Procter & Gamble Hygiene and Health Care (Final Dividend of ₹60), Suprajit Engineering (Final Dividend of ₹2).

: Chemfab Alkalis (Final Dividend of ₹1.25), Dr Agarwals Eye Hospital (Final Dividend of ₹4), GAIL (Final Dividend of ₹0.5), Gujarat Pipavav (Final Dividend of ₹5), India Glycols (Spin Off into three separate entities), NTPC (Final Dividend of ₹3.5), TBZ (Final Dividend of ₹2.5), Triveni Turbine (Final Dividend of ₹2).

Action Construction Equipment (Final Dividend of ₹2), Carraro India (Final Dividend of ₹6.75), Interarch Building Solutions (Final Dividend of ₹12.5), Nirlon (Final Dividend of ₹15), Vadilal Industries (Dividend of ₹43).

AIA Engienering (Dividend of ₹16), Arvind (Final Dividend of ₹4.5), Clean Science and Technology (Final Dividend of ₹4), Coal India (Final Dividend of ₹5.25), Emcure Pharma (Final Dividend of ₹3.6), Federal-Mogul Goetze India (Interim + Special Dividend of ₹94), General Insurance Corporation of India (Final Dividend of ₹13.5), Gulf Oil Lubricants (Final Dividend of ₹30), IndiGo Paints (Final Dividend of ₹5), Metro Brands (Final Dividend of ₹3), ONGC & Oil India (Final Dividend of ₹1 each), Shipping Corporation of India (Final Dividend of ₹3), Stove Kraft (Final Dividend of ₹3.5).
